name: Hexagon 3
description: v1's Hexagon 3: a tilted honeycomb of 466 nuclei (6 up + 6 down quarks, nuclear charge alternating ±1 around each hexagon) under v1's sine nuclear force (range 500) and Coulomb (k = 1/60), shot by a beam of 1230 electrons in 500 bunches flying in from the left at speed 250 (they arrive from t ≈ 60). Gravity (G = 1e-6) is negligible and omitted.
